name: hookdeck-agent-skills
description: Hookdeck plugin marketplace: skills for Hookdeck Event Gateway, Hookdeck Outpost and Hookdeck Inspect.

plugins.name: hookdeck
plugins.description: Skills for working with Hookdeck Event Gateway (receive, queue, route, and deliver webhooks), Hookdeck Outpost (send webhooks and events to user-preferred destinations) and Hookdeck Inspect (free webhook test URLs: create one, wait for webhooks, and read what they sent). Includes a router skill that delegates to event-gateway, outpost or inspect based on the task.
